string.name: fieldwatch_signatures_description
string.value: Built-in stock signatures plus your own rules. A match is a likely product family, not a confirmed identity.

string.name: fieldwatch_signatures_delete_confirm
string.value: This cannot be undone. Delete this custom signature?

string.name: fieldwatch_signatures_restore_confirm
string.value: Restoring defaults removes every custom signature and edit. Continue?

string.name: fieldwatch_signatures_offline
string.value: Updating needs network and only runs when you tap it.

string.name: fieldwatch_signatures_import_failed
string.value: Import failed, the catalog is unchanged

string.name: fieldwatch_signatures_update_failed
string.value: Update failed, kept the previous catalog

string.name: fieldwatch_signatures_create_from_device
string.value: Create a signature from this device

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_attention_hint
string.value: Non-empty marks the radio on Live and shows in detail

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_no_rules
string.value: No rules yet; add at least one

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_decode_fields_hint
string.value: Fields read from the payload by offset and length.

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_gate_hint
string.value: len compares the total payload length; eq/neq/mask/nmask compare at offset and length.

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_named_hint
string.value: The raw value is the decoded decimal text. On a hit the display text replaces it and Strong uses a louder Live chip.

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_location_tagging
string.value: Record where the phone heard the device

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_travel_status
string.value: GPS track %s m. Keep moving (about 50 m) to enable the co-travel test.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_reset_body
string.value: Clears every switch and pick on this tab. Presets you saved stay.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_logic_hint
string.value: AND/OR applies to name, OUI, RSSI, and class include — not to radios, Named radios only, Watched only, or Hide Fast Pair.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_selected_hint
string.value: Turn signatures on in the catalog. An empty list has no effect. Your picks stay if you toggle this off and on.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_classes_hint
string.value: Live only — signatures still label, log, and can beep. Show only with no class picked leaves Live unchanged.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_fastpair_hint
string.value: Plaza noise: already-paired Fast Pair chips with no other signature. Keeps pairing mode.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_named_hint
string.value: A random / privacy MAC will not follow a rotation.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_watched_hint
string.value: Only radios that match a watched signature, or a named radio with alert on.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_signatures_only_hint
string.value: Show only radios that match a catalog signature.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_new_hint
string.value: Hide radios already here so only new ones show on Live. Randomized BLE addresses look new.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_moving_hint
string.value: Turn on Settings → Tag detections with GPS, then walk or drive. Only loud BLE advertisers that stay with you remain.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_radios_hint
string.value: These are inclusive switches. Turn all three on to see Wi-Fi, BLE and NearLink together. A single device belongs to only one.

string.name: fieldwatch_filter_presets_hint
string.value: Tap to replace the whole filter, long-press to delete. A few are built in; “Save current as…” adds your own. Built-in presets you deleted can be restored via Signatures → More → Restore default catalog.

string.name: fieldwatch_hunt_hint_very_close
string.value: Screaming loud here. Look around — usually in-hand, pocket, or the same bag. Not meters.

string.name: fieldwatch_hunt_hint_closer
string.value: Louder than a few seconds ago. Keep walking that way.

string.name: fieldwatch_hunt_hint_further
string.value: Quieter than a few seconds ago. Turn or back up.

string.name: fieldwatch_hunt_hint_same
string.value: No clear change yet. Slow down; hold the device still.

string.name: fieldwatch_hunt_hint_waiting
string.value: Need a few seconds of packets to compare.

string.name: fieldwatch_hunt_hint_quiet
string.value: No packet for a few seconds. Silent, or behind a wall.

string.name: fieldwatch_hunt_hint_gone
string.value: Left the live set. Randomized BLE often vanishes mid-hunt.

string.name: fieldwatch_hunt_tick_unavailable
string.value: This device has no haptic tick; feedback is visual only.

string.name: fieldwatch_hunt_disclaimer
string.value: Hunt compares loudness only. It gives no bearing and is not a direction finder.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_export_pending
string.value: Export awaits system file and share integration

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_pdf_pending
string.value: PDF remains pending API26 capability validation

string.name: fieldwatch_local_file_hint
string.value: Files are stored in the app sandbox; public-folder save is pending validation

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_notifications_hint
string.value: Send a system notification when a watched device first appears

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_background_hint
string.value: Requires system background permission; off by default and remains passive

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_sits_hint
string.value: A sit is a named window of radios heard here.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_no_sit_running
string.value: No sit running. Start sit here.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_start_hint
string.value: Debrief and AI Export use this window until you end it.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_delete_all_hint
string.value: Removes saved sits from this phone.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_sit_report_hint
string.value: Debrief uses the same window as Path.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_show_unmatched_hint
string.value: Off (default): Debrief lists skip unmatched RAND BLE.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_export_hint
string.value: One row per unique radio in this sit.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_compare_hint
string.value: Save a second sit to compare.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_catalog_hint
string.value: Unmatched radios in the log that share a unique ID.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_log_hint
string.value: The rotating file is JSON lines.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_clear_hint
string.value: This deletes all rotated records on the phone. It cannot be undone.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_path_hint
string.value: North up. The line is this phone. The grey dot is the start. The blue dot is you. Green = matched signature, amber = unmatched.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_path_empty
string.value: No path yet. Turn on Settings → Tag detections with GPS and walk.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_pdf_failed
string.value: PDF generation failed: the device may not support PDFKit.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_save_ok
string.value: Saved to the location you chose.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_save_cancel
string.value: Cancelled, or the picker returned no location.

string.name: fieldwatch_reports_no_candidates
string.value: No candidates. Unmatched radios are randomized, house-like, or share no unique on-air ID.

string.name: fieldwatch_onb_welcome_body
string.value: A receive-only passive listener that shows what is broadcasting around you: who, what name, which class. It never connects, injects, or uploads.

string.name: fieldwatch_onb_p1_body
string.value: It only listens to advertisements. It never connects, pairs, injects, or interferes.

string.name: fieldwatch_onb_p2_body
string.value: Offline by default. The app only reaches the network when you explicitly tap “Update bundled catalog” under Signatures → More.

string.name: fieldwatch_onb_p3_body
string.value: The catalog, Wi-Fi scanning, log browsing, report export, and settings need no consent from you.

string.name: fieldwatch_onb_baseline_body
string.value: These work right away, with no permission granted:

string.name: fieldwatch_baseline_catalog
string.value: Catalog: browse, search, edit, import and export signatures

string.name: fieldwatch_baseline_log
string.value: Observations: browse saved sits and logs

string.name: fieldwatch_baseline_report
string.value: Reports: debrief, compare, AI export from existing data

string.name: fieldwatch_baseline_settings
string.value: Settings: theme, language, privacy mode, notifications & voice, log level

string.name: fieldwatch_onb_baseline_hint
string.value: None of the above needs authorisation. “Device discovery and connection” is what receives broadcasts; you can enable it any time under Settings → Permissions.

string.name: fieldwatch_onb_perm_body
string.value: Only Device discovery and connection and Location need your consent, asked one at a time. Wi-Fi scanning is granted by the system automatically.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_ble_why
string.value: To receive nearby BLE advertisements (buds, bands, trackers, beacons). Only the advertisement contents are read; no connection or pairing is made.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_ble_feature
string.value: Powers: BLE radios on Live, moving-with-you, watch alerts.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_ble_denied
string.value: If denied: BLE advertisements cannot be received and Live shows Wi-Fi access points only.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_wifi_why
string.value: To list nearby Wi-Fi access points with their names, bands, and signal strength. It never joins a network.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_wifi_feature
string.value: Powers: Wi-Fi radios on Live, AP classification, vendor lookup by OUI.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_wifi_denied
string.value: If denied: Wi-Fi access points cannot be scanned.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_loc_why
string.value: Used only after you turn on Tag detections with GPS, to stamp observations and draw your own track. No background location.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_loc_feature
string.value: Powers: the path canvas, located radios, moving-with-you.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_loc_denied
string.value: If denied: observations carry no location and the path stays empty.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_net_why
string.value: Used only when you explicitly tap “Update bundled catalog” under Signatures → More, to download the latest signature catalog. The app never goes online in the background.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_net_feature
string.value: Powers: updating the built-in signature catalog.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_net_denied
string.value: If denied: the built-in signature catalog cannot be updated.

string.name: fieldwatch_restricted_title
string.value: Device discovery and connection is off

string.name: fieldwatch_restricted_body
string.value: Receiving BLE advertisements needs Device discovery and connection in system settings. We never pop the system dialog on our own — it appears only when you tap the button below.

string.name: fieldwatch_restricted_baseline
string.value: Wi-Fi scanning needs no permission and always works; the catalog, observations, report export, and settings work too.

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_permissions_hint
string.value: Only Device discovery and connection and Location need your consent — the names match system settings exactly. Wi-Fi scanning is granted by the system automatically.

string.name: fieldwatch_missing_body
string.value: Missing "%s". It matches the same-named item in system settings; granting it enables BLE advertisement reception.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_rssi_note
string.value: Closer to 0 dBm is louder here, not a distance.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_connectable_yes
string.value: Yes — a phone could open a BLE connection

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_connectable_no
string.value: No — broadcast-only (you can hear it, not join it from this scan)

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_phy_unavailable
string.value: Radio PHY and advertising interval are not exposed by this platform's scan API.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_hidden_ssid_yes
string.value: Hidden — the AP is beaconing but not publishing a name

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_company_note
string.value: This ID is assigned by the Bluetooth SIG, carried in vendor-specific data.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_last_fix_note
string.value: Last fix is the phone's GPS at hear-time, not a fix on this radio.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_signature_note
string.value: Matched %s. A second signature can still dual-label this radio (service UUID, product OUI).

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_footer
string.value: This detail comes from what the device advertises — not a visual ID, and not an identity.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_unlisted
string.value: Not in the Bluetooth company list

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_presence_none
string.value: No presence recorded in the last 15 minutes.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_vendor_ieee
string.value: IEEE board/chip vendor: %s (%o). This is who owns the MAC prefix, not always the product brand.

string.name: fieldwatch_mode_wifi
string.value: Wi-Fi only (device discovery and connection is off)

string.name: fieldwatch_manual_title
string.value: The system will not prompt again

string.name: fieldwatch_manual_body
string.value:
"%s" will not be prompted again — you denied it earlier, or turned it off in system settings.

Please enable it manually: %p

string.name: fieldwatch_manual_toast
string.value: Could not open system settings. Please go to Settings → Apps → Airwave Footprints and enable the permission.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_ble_where
string.value: Settings → Apps → Airwave Footprints → Device discovery and connection

string.name: fieldwatch_baseline_wifi
string.value: Wi-Fi scanning: already granted by the system, no action needed

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_radar_display_hint
string.value: Choose what each signal shows on the radar, and adjust text and icon size. Changes apply instantly, no restart.

string.name: nearlink_scan_reason
string.value: To receive nearby NearLink advertisements so the app can passively discover and display surrounding NearLink signals. The app never connects, pairs, or transfers data.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_nl_why
string.value: To receive nearby NearLink advertisements, reading device name, signal strength and advertisement contents. Passive listening only — no connection, pairing, or data transfer.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_nl_feature
string.value: Powers: NearLink radios on Live, device type identification, signature matching.

string.name: fieldwatch_perm_nl_denied
string.value: If denied: NearLink advertisements cannot be received and Live shows no NearLink devices.

string.name: fieldwatch_scan_nearlink_unsupported
string.value: NearLink is not supported on this device

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_nl_address_note
string.value: Note: a NearLink device's real MAC address requires a system-level permission this app does not hold. The value shown is a system-assigned identifier that may change over time and is not a stable device identity.

string.name: fieldwatch_notification_permission_reason
string.value: With notifications allowed, the app shows a persistent notification while scanning in the background, so you always know it is running and how many radios it has found.

string.name: fieldwatch_background_running
string.value: Scanning nearby radio signals in the background

string.name: fieldwatch_about_principle
string.value: Strictly offline. The app makes no network calls unless you tap Update signature catalog.

string.name: fieldwatch_about_permissions
string.value: Only two permissions are needed: receiving Bluetooth and NearLink broadcasts (shown as Device discovery and connection in Settings), plus optional location.

string.name: fieldwatch_about_license
string.value: Ported from the open-source project Fieldwatch 1.1.17 under its original license.

string.name: fieldwatch_about_radiodb
string.value: The local OUI vendor database comes from IEEE public registry data.

string.name: fieldwatch_about_local
string.value: All observations stay on this device and are never uploaded.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_custom_name_hint
string.value: Changes the display name on Live only. The bookmark (top-right) is the alert; this does not turn it on.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_custom_name_blocked
string.value: This radio uses a random address that rotates. A name would stick to a dead key, so naming is disabled.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_notes_hint
string.value: Pinned to this address. Shows on Debrief, Compare, Path, and text export. Does not turn Alert on.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_gone
string.value: Not on the air. This is the last detail we heard.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_attention_note
string.value: Pattern match, not identity. Not a safety finding.

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_watch_beep_hint
string.value: Two beeps when a device appears; separate from the continuous tick on the hunt page

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_watch_voice_hint
string.value: Speaks after the double beep; falls back to beeps only when the system voice engine is unavailable

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_compact_rows_hint
string.value: Strength, Timeline, Trail and Class share one row style; this only switches the size. Compact fits more devices per screen.

string.name: fieldwatch_wifi_throttle_hint
string.value: The system throttles Wi-Fi scanning (usually once every few tens of seconds per app). After a failure it backs off by 8/16/32/45 seconds; the countdown above is the time until the next attempt.

string.name: fieldwatch_detail_name_locked
string.value: This is a randomized address that rotates over time; naming it would bind to an address that may never be heard again, so it is disabled.

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_notes_hint
string.value: Shown on the detail page of matching radios and in Share / AI export. It is only a description, not Extra attention — no “!” on Live and no amber card.

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_category_hint
string.value: Corresponds to Filters → Show only / Hide these. The per-class preset chips (trackers, cameras, …) are these.

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_match_any_hint
string.value: On: any single rule matching counts. Off: every rule must match.

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_cluster_oui_hint
string.value: Treats a batch of devices sharing a vendor prefix as one signature family instead of separate ones.

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_sequential_mac_hint
string.value: Recognizes device groups whose addresses increment sequentially (same production batch, powered on together).

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_peer_hint
string.value: Only applies when Min peers is above 0: at least that many peers must be heard within the time window for a match.

string.name: fieldwatch_editor_color_hint
string.value: Stock colors are by class (red pentest, amber cameras/ALPR, purple phones/tags, cyan wearables, green mesh, orange audio/glasses, teal in-vehicle). Any of them can be changed.

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_legal_hint
string.value: Terms, privacy notes and open-source notices. All content ships offline; no network request is made.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_privacy_p1
string.value: This app is a strictly offline radio-signal observation tool. It only receives what nearby devices broadcast on their own; it does not connect, pair, or transmit anything. The app has no networking capability and never uploads your information to any server.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_privacy_p2
string.value: Only two permissions are requested: “Device discovery and connection” to receive Bluetooth Low Energy and NearLink broadcasts, and “Location”, used only after you enable “record where the phone heard the device”, to tag observations and draw your own track. If you decline, everything except those features still works.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_privacy_p3
string.value: All observations, the watchlist, custom signatures and settings are stored in the app sandbox on this device. Uninstalling the app deletes them; we hold no copy and cannot recover them for you. You can clear logs or restore defaults at any time under Settings → Data.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_privacy_p4
string.value: The app collects no device identifiers, performs no analytics, shows no ads and requests no background location. It does not scan in the background unless you explicitly enable “Background scanning” and accept the battery cost.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_terms_p1
string.value: This app observes and analyses radio signals that are publicly broadcast in your environment, for learning, research and self-audit purposes.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_terms_p2
string.value: You are responsible for ensuring your use complies with local laws. Signal strength, vendor inference, signature matching and device explanations are inferences drawn from broadcast content only; they do not confirm a device's identity, ownership or intent and must not be the sole basis for evidence or decisions.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_terms_p3
string.value: The app is provided as is, without warranty of availability, accuracy or fitness for a particular purpose. Any consequence of using it rests with the user.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_oss_p1
string.value: Built with HarmonyOS ArkTS and ArkUI, using system capabilities and HDS design components shipped with the HarmonyOS SDK. Those components are governed by their own licences.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_oss_p2
string.value: Vendor prefix (OUI) resolution uses the publicly published IEEE MA-L / MA-M / MA-S registries. That data is public factual information, bundled offline with the app and never updated over the network.

string.name: fieldwatch_legal_oss_p3
string.value: The bundled signature catalog is compiled by this project from public product documentation and community records. It ships offline, can be exported for inspection, and can be overridden by your own rules.

string.name: fieldwatch_settings_log_level_hint
string.value: Defaults to Warn. Lower it only while troubleshooting: scan-time logging is heavy and a low level slows the device and buries what matters.
